verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with an endpoint reference, rate limits, webhooks, UI integrations, custom channels and an MCP server. Nothing mentions any official client SDK or language library, and probes found no OpenAPI spec from which SDKs could be generated. A raw REST API is a different capability from an official SDK, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
